test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Six presidents with the initials O, P, S, B, N and K are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre and at equal distance from each other, not necessarily in the same order.

P sits exactly between B and S. N sits exactly between K and O. B sits at the immediate right of K. O sits at the immediate right of S. Who sits second to the left of O?
solution:
Given: Six presidents O, P, S, B, N and K.

1) B sits at the immediate right of K.

2) P sits exactly between B and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a3e050fd54444def120fbdb650e2b1fb9998078602ad777f934f2bd322fe163.png] 

3) O sits at the immediate right of S.

4) N sits exactly between K and O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17c0f34b9e5d2cfda7c56df2a5bbdfcd299be0cd9b1242cb45009d55f2dff923.png] 

So, 'P' sits second to the left of O.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
